title: Go's Substrate enum has no cloud value
description:
From b6e gap 3. internal/herd/config/types.go knows herdr, harness and auto only, so a repository cannot declare [orchestration].substrate = "cloud" and have tk agree it means anything. That is why b6e triggers the per-tick-container path on the SUBMISSION carrying tick_ids rather than on repo config — a workaround, and a reasonable one, but it means the substrate a repo declares and the substrate a run actually uses can disagree with nothing to reconcile them.

Extend the enum and decide what tk does differently once it is set, including what tk herd spawn should do when a repo says cloud. bmo depends on this being real rather than implied.
